method: Browser video playback and paused on-screen counter readings; HTML video duration/currentTime. No backend access or original arrival trace.
limitations: Approximate counter observations at selected frames, not exact per-message timestamps. Input text for the NInfer replay is synthetic, not copied from the demo. UI counters distinguish raw received from admitted and API calls; these do not prove the unseen backend's batching implementation. Matching the average does not establish burst responsiveness.
